R7BD-duck-walk-0002.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).

evidence.t: Jack Lake, 28.6 ha, 350 m from the road.
About 3 wetlands within 2 km (estimate): ducks move between them.
Elevation 900 m: under 900 m, open water later in fall.

seasonRows.notes: District 7. Within the 8 a day: 4 northern pintails, 4 canvasbacks, 2 Barrow's or common goldeneyes together, 2 harlequins. Possession 24: 12, 12, 6, 6.

plan: Drive: from Fort Ware, about 17 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 57.33129, -125.75572, pull off on Sz6000 (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 350 m E, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 7 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-40, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2023-03-14, closures 2026-10-16.
